steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Contraception is one of the most debated issues in religious ethics. Christians and Muslims have different — and internally diverse — views on whether it is acceptable. | RS Exam Tips — Contraception and Family Planning: 1. For Contraception and Family Planning questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Contraception and Family Planning to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
